english_draft: Intel published Q3 2025 results on Oct 23, 2025. Q3 revenue was $13.7 billion. Q3 GAAP EPS was $0.90. Q3 non-GAAP EPS was $0.23. For Q4 2025, Intel guides revenue from $12.8 billion to $13.8 billion. The midpoint is $13.3 billion. Intel guides Q4 GAAP EPS to $(0.14). Intel guides Q4 non-GAAP EPS to $0.08. Q4 gross margin guidance is 34.5% GAAP and 36.5% non-GAAP. Q4 guidance excludes Altera. Intel sold 51% of Altera during Q3 2025. Three core questions exist. First, can demand exceed supply? Management said demand exceeds supply. This trend may continue into 2026. Q4 revenue midpoint is still below Q3 revenue. Second, how does Altera exclusion distort comparisons? Q3 figures include Altera until September 11, 2025. Q4 guidance excludes Altera. Users should analyze segment revenue. Third, can users trust the Q3 baseline? Q3 results are preliminary. Intel consulted the SEC. The U.S. government shutdown delayed the consultation. Q3 results may be revised. Watch items: revenue range, non-GAAP EPS, gross margin, segment revenue, Altera separation, and any Q3 restatement. There is no contemporaneous preview. This document is a historical reconstruction.
reader_questions: 若SEC咨询导致Q3财务结果被重大重述，这份预览基于的Q3基线和Q4指引是否还有参考价值？

Q4 GAAP EPS指引为亏损而non-GAAP EPS为正，两者之间的差异主要来自哪些一次性或非经营项目？
